title: hive-pool export-legacy: request body
description: Renders Pool items in the legacy Markdown format and returns the text. It writes no file: the caller decides where the text goes. With a migration, an item unmodified since its import is emitted from its exact original lines and a modified item is re-rendered canonically; the free-form lines, preamble and section order of the source are kept. Read-only.

migration_id.description: Export the items of this migration in the source's order and form. Without it, every item the selector matches is rendered canonically.

zone.description: The zone calendar dates are written in.

normalize.description: True: re-render every item canonically, as the legacy render verb does. Absent means false.
